title: Rhythm Press
description: A living cyberpunk collage: drifting paper, floating record machine, orbital rings and flowing print strips, with continuous vinyl rotation and four distinct musical movements.

parameters.label: Rotation
parameters.description: Continuous rotation and layered scene motion, with smooth bass acceleration and lift.

parameters.label: Color Split
parameters.description: Spread of color cutouts, background sheets and the deck fader.

parameters.label: Signal Etch
parameters.description: Strength and travel of print hatching, electronic rails and groove circuits.

parameters.label: Cut Impact
parameters.description: Percussive print-layer separation, chassis breath and needle fragments.

parameters.label: Framing
parameters.description: Scale of the record machine collage.

parameters.label: Cut Angle
parameters.description: Angle of the color fragments printed on the record.

parameters.label: Groove Density
parameters.description: Spacing of the coarse grooves and print hatching.

parameters.label: Accent Color
parameters.description: Main cut-paper accent used for the label, chassis and print fragments.

provenance.prompt_summary: Cyberpunk turntable collage with continuously moving paper layers, floating rigid machine, rotating vinyl, orbiting rings and flowing print. Preserve the four accepted musical actions.
